items.name: Polynomial.coeff_bdd_of_roots_le
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {B : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (f : F →+* K)
  {p : Polynomial F},
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      p.natDegree ≤ d →
        (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
          ∀ (i : ℕ), ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ max B 1 ^ d * ↑(d.choose (d / 2))

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_le_of_roots_le
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_3} {K : Type u_4} [inst : CommRing F] [inst_1 : NormedField K] {p : Polynomial F} {f : F →+* K} {B : ℝ}
  (i : ℕ),
  p.Monic →
    (Polynomial.map f p).Splits →
      (∀ z ∈ (Polynomial.map f p).roots, ‖z‖ ≤ B) →
        ‖(Polynomial.map f p).coeff i‖ ≤ B ^ (p.natDegree - i) * ↑(p.natDegree.choose i)

  BddAbove (f '' t) → MonotoneOn f t → s ⊆ t → (∀ y ∈ t, ∃ x ∈ s, y ≤ x) → sSup (f '' s) = sSup (f '' t)
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ be a preorder and $\beta$ a conditionally complete lattice. For a function $f : \alpha \to \beta$ that is monotonic on a set $t \subseteq \alpha$, if $s \subseteq t$ is a subset such that every element of $t$ is bounded above by some element of $s$, and the image $f(t)$ is bounded above in $\beta$, then the supremum of $f(s)$ equals the supremum of $f(t)$, i.e., $\sup(f(s)) = \sup(f(t))$.

request.query: conditionally complete lattice supremum monotone subset nonempty bounded above
